title: Pooled training versus pairing
models: DenseNet121, EfficientNet-B3, ResNet50, RETFound (5-class), 3 runs each, trained on EyePACS v2 train + DDR official train (concatenated, no reweighting); best epoch on EyePACS v2 val + DDR official valid (AUC, referable); canonical recipe; seeds 20261101 + 10 x design index + run

test_sets.primary: BRSET, f = 1.31 x referable prevalence, patient bootstrap
secondary: DDR official test, f = 1.31 x referable prevalence in that file, filename groups

outcome: missed severe DR (grade 3 or 4) per 10,000 at the same referral share; referable and PDR secondary; ties at the margin broken at random (expected value)

comparisons_brset_severe.C1: pooled single vs EyePACS-only single, matched design and run; prediction: pooled misses fewer
comparisons_brset_severe.C2: pooled single (average of 12) vs mixed-source pair (EyePACS design a + DDR design b, a != b, 9 run combinations); prediction: pooled misses fewer
comparisons_brset_severe.C3: pair of pooled models (different designs, 9 run combinations) vs pooled average member; prediction: pair misses fewer; vs better member reported without prediction
comparisons_brset_severe.C4: pair of pooled models vs EyePACS-only pair (different designs); prediction: pair of pooled misses fewer

decision: supported if the 95% patient-bootstrap interval (1,000 resamples) of the difference excludes zero in the predicted direction; contradicted if it excludes zero the other way; otherwise inconclusive
brset_role: test only; never used for training or model selection
